name: Homeward Stone (Goldenhaven)
description: A sandy gold ember-scale stone with a sun rune. It pulls toward the waystone in Goldenhaven's square.
notes: Use it to teleport to the waystone in Goldenhaven's town square. It isn't used up.
All Homeward Stones share one charge: after any of them carries you, none works for a week.
Not in a fight, a dungeon or a party. Using one on the road abandons the trip. No time passes.
Sold by the vault keeper in Goldenhaven.
